title: l89 closes any blocked tick that carries any acceptable tracker edit
description:
acceptTrackerEdits treats every BLOCKED/no-commits report with an acceptable tracker edit as the delivery and closes the tick, without checking the edit answers the blocking question; only the standing orders' always-ask class guards it. A 'BLOCKED — acceptance ambiguous' report proposing a clarifying edit to its own tick closes with no code. Tests cover only the yjq shape.
